payload.body: GO from hv (molt-vc's TUI, 1 Nov; vc decision 42): Flynn's zshenv takes the env.sh line now, which releases your hold 15. path_add and path_prepend stay copied in each stack, with no change. Build: a branch off Molt-flynn main ae07fe2, in a worktree under $TMPDIR/molt-wt, and one commit to config/zsh/zshenv adding Molt-matts' line, [ -r ~/.config/molt/env.sh ] && . ~/.config/molt/env.sh, where Molt-matts' sits: after the directory variables and before the PATH fallback. Its comment says what the file holds (lib/env.sh: every variable Molt publishes to shells) and that it exists only on a sleeve where Molt wrote it. The subject follows 0079's style, ending "(found in Molt issue 0079; hv, 1 Nov)". Run zsh -n on it and report the branch head. Run no proof of your own: I book one light for my script on the new head plus a scratch env.sh marker check, then merge. Nothing is pushed. Also widen 0078's title so it names both remedies (from the main checkout), since a title naming only doctor's hint lets the second ask be missed at the next release.
